title: Phantom Camera
summary: Virtual 2D and 3D cameras that drive the real camera: follow modes, damping, level limits, look-at, third person, shake, and tweened switches by priority.
useWhen: The game needs a camera that smoothly follows a player or a group, stays inside level bounds, shakes on impacts, orbits in third person, or cuts and blends between shots such as rooms, shops, cutscenes or boss intros.
avoidWhen: One Camera2D or Camera3D on the player, with Godot's built-in limits and position smoothing, already frames the game well.
